experiment_data.hypothesis: Scale verification: Pythia-1.4B T=10 α=0.50. At 410M, α=0.50 is the onset boundary (T=10 PermG=6/8). If 1.4B also shows 6/8, confirms detection onset is scale-invariant. If different, reveals model-size dependence of α_c.
